// about: DROP-IN for a project's checked-in .claude/settings.json. Pins the quetrex-factory engine plugin from the private Glori-Holdings/quetrex-plugins marketplace and sets a tight allow + defense-in-depth deny list. Copy this whole object into .claude/settings.json (strip the // comment keys if your linter dislikes them — Claude Code ignores unknown keys, so they are safe to leave). Commit it so every teammate and every spawned agent inherits the same floor.
// permission-mode: defaultMode:'auto' is DELIBERATELY NOT set here. Since Claude Code v2.1.142 defaultMode:'auto' is honored ONLY in a user's own ~/.claude/settings.json — it is IGNORED in project and plugin settings. Each developer must add {"permissions":{"defaultMode":"auto"}} to their OWN ~/.claude/settings.json (Team/Enterprise orgs can instead enforce it via a managed-settings.json floor). Setting it in this project file does nothing. Auto mode does NOT weaken the guards: PreToolUse deny hooks (deny-guard, secret-scan, enforce-branch, enforce-merge-approval), the Stop/SubagentStop verify-gate, and the permissions.deny list below all still fire (a blocking hook and the deny list are evaluated before any permission grant).
// marketplace: Source repo is PRIVATE — teammates need `gh auth login` (or a GH token) with read access to Glori-Holdings/quetrex-plugins for the plugin to resolve on first launch.

permissions.// precedence: Order is deny > ask > allow. The deny list below is defense-in-depth: it holds even in a project that has not installed the managed-settings.json org floor, and it backstops the deny-guard PreToolUse hook. The allow list is scoped to the pipeline's real git/gh/worktree + package-runner + docs traffic so routine steps don't prompt — it is NOT a blanket Bash(*).
permissions.// allow-scope: Stack-specific verification runners (typecheck/lint/build/test) come from the project's .quetrex/verify.json and are exercised by the verify-gate, not granted here; add any extra project-specific runners to .claude/settings.local.json rather than widening this shared file.
permissions.// deny-note: These are intentionally redundant with the deny-guard hook so a stale-green / mis-wired hook never leaves the destructive path open. Deny wins over any allow above and over auto mode.
